mechanics.claim: Half of the total damage, healing and resistance reduction is applied instantly on cast; the other half is applied in ticks every second over the next 4 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Half of the drain's '''total''' damage, healing, and resistances reduction is applied on-cast, while the other half is applied every second over the next 4 seconds.

mechanics.claim: The ability snapshots the target's maximum health, total armor, and total magic resist at cast; the remaining drain ticks use these snapshotted values even if the target's stats change afterward.
mechanics.quote: ''Subjugate'' will snapshot the values of the target's '''current''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}, {{as|'''total''' armor}}, and {{as|'''total''' magic resistance}} as soon as it completes its cast.

mechanics.claim: The healing Trundle receives is equal to the damage dealt, applied on the same schedule (half instant, half over ticks).
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for the same amount

mechanics.claim: Trundle gains the resistances reduced from the target as bonus armor and magic resist for himself, for as long as they remain reduced (including during the lingering period).
mechanics.quote: '''Trundle''' will gain the reduced resistances of the target for himself for as long as they remain reduced, including while they are lingering after the drain.

mechanics.claim: The resistance reduction is gradual: 20% is applied on-cast and an additional 5% per tick over 4 ticks, totaling 40% reduction by the end of the drain.
mechanics.quote: The target's resistances will be further reduced by 5% per drain tick, up to 20% by the end of the drain (totaling to 40% reduction from the initial 20% reduction on-cast).

mechanics.claim: The debuff (and its damage/resistance-reduction ticks) persists even if the target dies.
mechanics.quote: The debuff on the target also ''persists through death''.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins on cast, not on effect end.
